hed.host.description: IP address or hostname to bind the ARC HED service to. Use 0.0.0.0 to listen on all interfaces.

hed.port.description: TCP port for the main ARC HED API service (HTTP/HTTPS).

hed.pidfile.description: Path to the file where the daemon writes its process ID.

hed.logfile.description: Path to the log file. Leave empty to log to stdout only.

hed.max_threads.description: Maximum number of worker threads to handle incoming requests.

hed.check_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between periodic health checks of hosting environments.

hed.ssl_enabled.description: Enable SSL/TLS encryption for the main service port (HTTPS).

hed.ssl_cert.description: Path to the SSL certificate file (PEM format). Required if SSL is enabled.

hed.ssl_key.description: Path to the SSL private key file (PEM format). Required if SSL is enabled.

hed.ssl_ca_cert.description: Path to the CA certificate chain (PEM format) for validating client certificates.

hed.client_cert_auth.description: Require and verify client certificates for authentication (mTLS).

hed.shared_dir.description: Directory for shared coordination files (e.g., lock files, state sync).

hed.exec_timeout.description: Maximum time (in seconds) allowed for external commands (e.g., job submission, status query).

hed.debug.description: Enable verbose debugging mode for troubleshooting.

hed.hetemplates_dir.description: Directory containing templates for hosting environment configuration files.

hed.hestate_dir.description: Directory to store runtime state of hosting environments.

hed.environments.description: List of ARC hosting environments to manage.

name.description: Unique name for the hosting environment.

enabled.description: Whether the hosting environment is active.

resources.description: List of resource names (from 'hed.resources') to associate with this hosting environment.

hed.resources.description: List of computing resources managed by ARC (referenced by hosting environments).

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the resource's ARC CE or scheduler.

port.description: Port used by the resource's ARC service (e.g., 2811 for gRPC, 8080 for REST).

auth_method.description: Authentication method to use when connecting to the resource.

proxy_cert.description: Path to the delegation proxy certificate (for GSSAPI or X.509 auth).

username.description: Username for password-based authentication (not stored in config by default).

password.description: Password (or credential reference) for password-based authentication. Use secure storage in production.

hed.monitoring.enabled.description: Enable the internal HTTP health/status endpoint (for load balancers/monitors).

hed.monitoring.port.description: Port for the monitoring endpoint (HTTP only).

hed.monitoring.path.description: URL path for the health check endpoint.
